uncited: This method samples opacity values from a precomputed 3D alpha mask volume for a set of 3D point positions, mapping the raw mask values to a specified opacity range.

It serves as the core sampling primitive for the Alpha Grid Mask module, enabling volume rendering to incorporate spatially varying opacity constraints derived from external supervision or geometry masks.

It differs from direct intensity sampling by applying a linear remapping to the sampled values to ensure they fall within a valid $[min\_opacity, max\_opacity]$ interval, preventing complete occlusion or invisibility artifacts.

- **When Not to Use:** When opacity is uniform or can be computed analytically without a mask.
